summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of Restaurant OPS BOM. Authored 38-test pytest regression suite covering auth (OTP/JWT/master-OTP/me), tenant isolation, menu items, raw materials, BOM versioning, suppliers, sales, inventory (current_stock sync), purchases (stock increment), wastage, prepared food, dashboard, variations engine, reports (sales/wastage/item-costing/low-stock), wallet (summary/topup), subscription mock Razorpay flow, super-admin (tenants/plans/revenue/status toggle, role-gating), and AI Insights (real Claude 4.5 call + ₹2 wallet deduction). Initial run hit 3 failures, all rooted in the same bug (Motor mutates dict with ObjectId after insert_one). Patched 3 endpoints (boms/sales/purchases) to pop '_id' before returning. After fix: 38/38 backend pass. Frontend smoke covered login flow (owner→/, super_admin→/admin), dashboard KPIs (Today's Sales ₹9,250, Profit ₹7,485, Red Alerts 10), bottom nav (Home/Sales/Stock/Menu/More), Variations (severity colors+messages), Sales list, New Sale form, Wallet, Subscription plans, Settings (lang/color), AI Insights, BOM, Super Admin (Tenants/Plans tabs).

minor.issue: Returned doc with mutated _id ObjectId from Motor insert_one (HTTP 500 on creation). FIXED by popping _id before return.

issues: Try-demo phone hint text uses very light grey on white — acceptable but could be slightly darker for contrast on small phones.

action_items: Optional: apply the same _id-pop pattern as a generic helper (e.g., insert-and-strip wrapper) in all routes to prevent regression elsewhere.
Optional: add explicit data-testid attributes to login phone/otp inputs and primary CTAs to make UI tests faster/more deterministic (current selectors worked via role/text).
Consider hashing/protecting JWT_SECRET more (currently a hard-coded dev value in .env).
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB _id leakage pattern: any time you reuse the dict passed to insert_one, ObjectId leaks into the JSON response. The fix applied here is local — auditing all routes for this pattern (or centralising via a helper) is recommended.
auth.py JWT_SECRET defaults to 'dev-secret' if env missing — keep that fail-fast in prod.
routes_analytics.py is large (~460 lines); compute_variations is intricate and would benefit from unit tests independent of HTTP.

wastage from inventory.wastage field is subtracted from actual_use but UI/route create_wastage in /api/wastage does NOT update inventory entries — slight duplication risk; ensure docs clarify which one drives variation severity.
AI Insights returns raw LLM text (possibly with code fences) — frontend should defensively parse before bullet-rendering.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` for a one-shot smoke. Master OTP 123456 always works. Use phone 9999999999 for tenant-owner flows and 1111111111 for super-admin. Fresh phones auto-create new tenants; use random phone for isolation tests. Backend has hot-reload. The fix applied was popping `_id` after insert_one on boms/sales/purchases — keep an eye on other endpoints if E1 adds new POSTs.
rca_of_the_issue: Motor's AsyncIOMotorCollection.insert_one mutates the input dict in place, appending `_id: ObjectId(...)`. Three endpoints (create_bom, create_sale, create_purchase) called `await db.X.insert_one(doc)` and then `return doc`, causing FastAPI's JSON serializer to raise 'ObjectId is not iterable' and return 500. Reproduction: POST /api/sales with a valid SaleIn body → 500. Mitigation applied: insert `doc.pop('_id', None)` before returning. Verified by re-running the failed 3 tests + full suite (38/38 pass).
